Overview

About Chocolate processing

ART Mechatronics provides complete turnkey solutions for chocolate manufacturing plants, offering advanced systems for mixing, refining, conching, tempering, moulding, cooling, and packaging. Our solutions are designed for high-quality production, consistent texture, and efficient large-scale operations for domestic and export markets.

How it works

Complete Chocolate Bar Process Flow

Raw Material Handling & Dosing

Ingredients such as cocoa powder, cocoa butter, sugar, milk solids, and additives are received and fed into the system.

Material Handling SystemsIngredient Dosing System

➜ Ensures precise formulation and consistency.

Mixing

Raw ingredients are mixed to form a homogeneous chocolate mass.

Chocolate Mixer

➜ Ensures uniform blending of ingredients.

Refining

Chocolate mass is refined to achieve smooth texture.

Ball Mill / Five Roller Refining Machine

➜ Ensures:

  • Fine particle size
  • Smooth mouthfeel
Conching

Chocolate is processed over time to develop flavor and texture.

Conching Machine

➜ Ensures:

  • Flavor enhancement
  • Removal of moisture and acidity
  • Improved texture
Tempering

Chocolate is temperature-controlled to stabilize cocoa butter crystals.

Chocolate Tempering Machine

➜ Ensures:

  • Glossy finish
  • Proper snap
  • Stable structure
Moulding / Depositing

Tempered chocolate is poured into moulds.

Chocolate Moulding Line

➜ Produces:

  • Chocolate bars
  • Filled chocolates
Cooling & Solidification

Moulded chocolate is cooled to set properly.

Cooling Tunnel

➜ Ensures:

  • Proper solidification
  • Shape retention
Demoulding

Chocolate bars are removed from moulds.

Packaging (HIGH-SPEED FMCG)

Finished chocolate bars are packed into wrappers.

Flow Wrap MachineChocolate Wrapping Machine

➜ Ensures:

  • Hygienic packaging
  • Extended shelf life
